name: limitations_delayed
description: 摘要、引言与Section 5没有实质limitations；专门限制段落位于Appendix I物理页17。

name: category_detail_moved
description: 正文Table 3聚合为3个physics levels；10类别明细移入Appendix H Table 9，正文的异质性判断需翻页核对。

name: paired_tables_moved
description: 4.5–4.6在正文给结论，Pass/Total表格位于Appendix Q页33。

name: failure_examples_only
description: Appendix L用12页、每模型5例失败图支撑定性分析；未并列成功/边界案例，也未声明这些图的抽样规则。

name: count_inconsistency
description: 摘要写“five open-source and five proprietary”但正文实际5 proprietary+7 open-source；Table 3 caption又写10 models而表中列12。

name: mechanism_claim_strength
description: 复杂度差异由比例点估计支持，却上升为“do not really understand”与“mimic training set”；缺直接机制观测。

name: appendix_migration_domain_filtering
description: The strongest cross-domain/no-domain-specific-tuning language is in the abstract and results, while harness-specific domain exclusion is disclosed in Appendix C.1.

name: appendix_migration_equal_scale
description: The equal-scale control that addresses data-volume confounding appears only in Appendix E.

name: undefined_aggregate
description: The ∼20% average omits included comparisons, weights, and uncertainty, aggregating gains ranging from 1.8 to 38.1 points.

name: loc_proxy_extrapolation
description: Raw→ADP LOC proxies Raw→SFT effort, and three harness converters are averaged then extrapolated to A=100; the paper explicitly labels the proxy and hypothetical A.

name: best_model_selection
description: Table titles say our Best, but no seed/checkpoint selection protocol is given; shaded ADP rows and heterogeneous prior-work rows shape the comparison.

name: negative_transfer_missing_base
description: §6.2 says Base is compared, but Table 6 has no Base rows, leaving the negative-transfer-below-base claim untestable from the shown table.

name: thought_coverage_aggregation
description: The prose emphasizes most datasets and overall 83.8% while Table 2 visibly retains Mind2Web 0.0% and SWE-Gym 42.0%; adverse values are auditable.

name: aggregate_claim_mismatch
description: §5.2 calls Tables 3–4 state of the art, while Table 3 Ours Avg=46.8 is below VG-LLM=47.3 and Gemini=52.7, and Table 4 CV Avg=90.7 is below VG-LLM=91.3; the text does not reconcile the aggregate rows.

name: synthetic_proxy_scope
description: The main cross-camera claim is carried by rescale-factor curves; real-camera evidence is a qualitative TUM-RGBD panel, so the stated deployment interpretation exceeds the quantitative design.

name: uncertainty_omission
description: All main result tables and curves show point scores without uncertainty or seed variation; this is a reporting gap rather than evidence of zero variation.

name: baseline_set_scope
description: Cross-camera quantitative comparisons use two task-finetuned baselines; the text excludes Gemini-2.5 on the stated 3D-localization rationale.

name: external appendix migration
description: Examples, k tuning, extra settings, failure analysis, and baseline details are deferred to the external extended version; the PDF gives pointers but no local appendix pages.

name: future-work deferral
description: Complementary neural/symbolic ensembling and additional automation are described as future investigation rather than tested extensions.

name: hedged explanation of adverse ablation
description: The higher −loss-mask cumul column is retained but explained with the hedge “we strongly believe” and attributed to random noise.

name: aggregate and relative framing
description: The paper reports split averages and relative-to-ground-truth ratios for generalization while retaining split values; the ratio is not a uniform per-domain guarantee.

name: baseline condition disclosure
description: The random-forest result is labelled an upper bound and the ReProver recall-definition mismatch is footnoted, making comparison conditions visible rather than silent.

name: appendix_migration_of_mechanism_evidence
description: The main body states four behavioral causes, while the analyses that support them are entirely in Appendix F (PDF p.21-p.25). This increases the evidence distance for the causal narrative.

name: aggregate_masks_heterogeneity
description: The headline 39% and model-level averages compress task heterogeneity; the prose partly repairs this by naming domain exceptions.

name: inferential_language_without_test_specification
description: Abstract and conclusion use 'significantly', but the methods specify empirical means/percentiles without a hypothesis test or estimator interval.

name: negative_scope_result_deferred
description: The translation task that does not degrade is placed in Appendix G.3, while the main-body title and abstract omit this episodic-task boundary.

name: active_discussion_of_adverse_design_facts
description: The authors proactively discuss the sharded scoring advantage, gradual-sample complexity, task exceptions, metric weaknesses, and simulator artificiality rather than hiding them.

name: sample_count_inconsistencies
description: Appendix L says both eight and 31 source instructions; Appendix D prose says 200 inspected conversations while Table 2 says 100. These are reader-cost/reporting inconsistencies, not evidence of intent.

name: important arithmetic caveat in footnote
description: fixed-precision 适用性的 evaluation-order caveat 放在物理页 3 的长脚注，而摘要/标题使用更宽泛的 transformer 表述。
strategy: 位置延后/脚注迁移；只描述可见位置，不推断意图。

name: proof-detail appendix migration
description: 七个 named results 的完整 proof 或 proof sketch 位于 A.1–A.7；正文均显式调用。
strategy: 附录迁移；正文保留 statement、proof idea 与依赖链。

name: unresolved architecture generalization as future work
description: softmax/average-hard succinctness 在结尾明示为 future work。
strategy: 未来工作化，同时清楚划定 theorem scope。

name: counter-artifact discussed positively
description: 作者主动指出 hardness 依赖 large counters，并建议寻找无法编码 counters 的 subclasses。
strategy: 主动正面讨论，不隐藏 worst-case mechanism。
